name: @w6w-apps/hedy
description: Read meeting sessions and AI-extracted highlights from Hedy.

w6w.longDescription:
Hedy is an AI meeting-notes and highlights product: it joins or records a meeting, then produces a transcript, a recap, structured meeting minutes, and a set of AI-extracted "highlights" — the individual quotes and moments the model judged worth surfacing, each with its own cleaned quote, AI insight, and timestamp.

This app covers the read side of that data: listing and reading meeting Sessions (transcript, recap, meeting minutes, structured conversation history) and listing and reading Highlights (the quote-level moments extracted from a session), so a workflow can pull a completed meeting's output into whatever comes next — a CRM note, a summary digest, a search index.

Hedy's own OpenAPI document also declares a Webhooks tag, but publishes no paths under it — nothing here was guessed to fill that gap.
